subject: ZenWell SOC 2 discovery - post-call recap & next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@zenwell.com>, Carlos Reyes <carlos.reyes@zenwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: ZenWell SOC 2 discovery - post-call recap & next steps

Hi Samira / Carlos —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call so we have alignment and next steps. Please reply with any corrections.

Summary of ZenWell's goals / pain points
- Compliance: ZenWell is preparing for SOC 2 Type II and needs a vendor-proof security posture for production data flows.
- Audit logs: Need confirmation on types of audit logs retained (auth, admin, model inference, config changes), retention windows, and export formats (CSV / JSON).
- Data retention & deletion: Requirements to delete customer data within 30 days upon request and a clear retention policy for cached inputs/KV store.
- DPA & data residency: Legal wants a DPA and clarity on EU data residency for EU customers.
- Pen test / evidence: ZenWell will require pen test reports or remediation statements for any issues affecting data flows.

What Redwood covered on the call
- SOC 2 status: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in progress; we shared scope (inference platform, control plane) and expected target date for attestation (Q3 2027).
- Audit logs: We described log collection (auth, request metadata, model routing, and admin actions), retention options, and how customers can export logs.
- DPA: We have a standard DPA template and support addenda for data residency clauses.
- Evidence: We can share whitepaper and selected artifacts; pen-test reports are available under NDA for customers with an enterprise contract.

Open questions / actions (owners & target dates)
1) Redwood to share SOC 2 scope summary + current test timeline — owner: Neha (me). ETA: 2027-05-24.
2) Redwood to provide a small sample of audit logs (sanitized) in CSV — owner: Rishi. ETA: 2027-05-25.
3) ZenWell to confirm specific retention window for inference logs and whether EU-only residency is required — owner: Samira. ETA: 2027-05-26.
4) Legal: send DPA template for ZenWell review; if ok, we’ll route for signature (DocuSign link) — owner: Neha. ETA: 2027-05-28.
5) If ZenWell requires pen-test report, we’ll provide redacted report under NDA — owner: Marissa. ETA: dependent on NDA.

Attachments I'm sending now:
- Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf (summary of controls and timeline)
- audit-logs-sample.csv (sanitized sample)
- Redwood_DPA_Template.docx (standard DPA)

Next steps: I’ll share the SOC 2 scope doc and upload those attachments to the HubSpot record. Please confirm the retention window and whether you need EU-only hosting.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: ZenWell SOC 2 discovery - post-call recap & next steps

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the clear summary and the quick turnaround on attachments. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Retention: For inference logs we need 13 months retention for audit purposes. For raw inputs (PII), we need deletion within 30 days unless specifically retained under a customer contract.
2) EU residency: Yes, for our EU business we require EU-only hosting; can Redwood guarantee inference and log retention within EU regions?
3) Pen-test: We will likely request the pen-test report after NDA. Please send NDA template or we can countersign yours.

We reviewed the SOC 2 summary — helpful. A couple of asks: any detail you can add about how we can pull a) admin change logs and b) per-tenant usage exports will help our security team.

I'll confirm internally and get back to the retention answer by 5/26.

Best,
Samira
Head of Security Operations | ZenWell
samira.khan@zenwell.com

Looping you in on ZenWell's asks. Quick notes for follow-up:
